ai_analysis.summary: This is a promotional post introducing a PySpark cheat sheet. It claims to cover aggregation, window, string, conditional, array and map utility, type conversion, and miscellaneous functions, but it provides no function names, syntax, examples, or technical explanations. The referenced technical content is therefore incomplete and cannot support substantive interview questions.
